subject: raccoon dog
title: This Wild Dog Gets 50% Fatter Every Fall, Then Sleeps Through Winter

scenes.text: Of all the dogs on Earth, only one sleeps through the winter.
It's the raccoon dog. Not a raccoon, but a true member of the dog family.
Every autumn it eats until it's up to fifty percent heavier.
Then a pair crawls into a burrow together and stays there through the coldest months.
It's a light sleep. On warm winter days, it can wake and wander out for food.
Wolves and foxes tough out the snow. This dog just skips it.

description:
The raccoon dog is the only member of the dog family known to hibernate: in the north of its range, it fattens up by as much as 50% and spends the coldest months, roughly November to early April, in a burrow, often as a pair.
It is a light winter sleep, and it may come out on warm days.
Would you skip winter if you could?
first_comment: In Japan the raccoon dog is called the tanuki. Had you ever heard of a dog that hibernates?
